build_procedure.policy_mix: first half of episodes: sage.domains.gym_taxi.simulator.ternary_scripted_policy.scripted_policy with random_prob=eps (nearest waiting passenger, then its destination via the picked_up_at/request join); second half: uniform random legal actions (ternary_scripted_policy.legal_actions)
build_procedure.rng: env.np_random = numpy RandomState(seed), assigned after construction (so the maze/spawn stream is the same on every gym version); policy: random.Random(seed); projection goals: numpy RandomState(seed)
